name: Ready SaaS Go

sources.title: Homepage — old SaaS directory (featured listings ~2014-era: Whisbi, BannerFlow, Pica9) with injected spam links (casino, OnlyFans directories, bank-statement tools)
Add Your Listing — form fields: company name, website, description, short description, screenshots, logo, email

requirements: SaaS products across a fixed taxonomy (BI & Analytics, Marketing, CRM, Security, Dev Tools, etc.)
Submission form at /submit-information-screenshots/ asks: company name, website, description, short description, screenshots, logo, email (email 'will not appear on website')
No payment is requested on the form — but no confirmation of active review either
workflow: Complete the listing form and upload logo/screenshots
Submit — there is no visible payment step, but also no stated review process or turnaround
watchFor: Site appears unmaintained: homepage copy is injected with off-topic spam links (Portuguese casino leon90.bet, 'free onlyfans' directories, bankstatementmaker.com) — a compromised/abandoned-installation signal
Featured listings are all ~2014-era companies — submissions may not be processed at all
If the listing does go live it may sit next to injected spam — reputation value is near zero
countsAsLive: A company profile page at readysaasgo.com/<slug>/ exists and is reachable from a category page — verify manually since review is unconfirmed
unknowns: Whether submissions are still reviewed/published (site looks abandoned since ~2015)
Whether the site is compromised vs. deliberately monetized with spam placements
